newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian Shipping Company to be privatized.
newsitem.headline: Estonian Shipping Company to be privatized.

text.p: The Estonian Privatization Agency (EPA) on Monday launched the sale of the Estonian Shipping Company (ESCO), EPA said in a statement.
EPA said that the state would sell off 70 percent of the shares in ESCO through a tender process.
Bids for the shipping company must be submitted by October 3.
ESCO, one of the most successful state-owned companies in the Baltic state, has a share capital of 107.9 million kroons and its turn-over in the first half of this year was 587 million kroons.
The company has 47 vessels and employs 2,385 people.
